reason: The README clearly positions this plugin as a user-facing tool for managing and compressing agent conversation context in DeepSeek Harness, with explicit commands to trim or compact dialogue regions; primary purpose is memory/context management for long sessions.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 `/compact-directive` 和 `/trim-directive` 命令，支持按自然语言要求压缩或裁剪会话上下文并生成新的上下文快照。
summaries.en: This plugin adds `/compact-directive` and `/trim-directive` commands to DeepSeek Harness so users can trim or compact conversation context by natural-language instructions and produce a new context checkpoint.

capabilities: Provides conversation compaction commands (`/compact-directive`, `/trim-directive`) that can delete, summarize, or rewrite message content based on user requirements
Supports a whole-session trim mode without head/protected-node guarantees, and documents destructive behavior with no direct undo

reasons.code: README defines two slash commands for context management and explains they can replace middle content or the whole conversation with summarized or edited nodes.

README states `/trim-directive` can delete any content in conversation (including injected system-like nodes) and that trims are destructive with no undo, with operation-mode manifests (`delete`, `rewrite`, `summarize`).
